data.narrative:
ASI is a Series B-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Phillip Buckendorf, Kris Dorosz, and Lucas Kukielka, having raised $56.1M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a comp universe of 5 public tickers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including Sierra Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Aalyria, and Skyryse.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses total capital raised ($56M) as a baseline proxy and applies a 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier, implying a valuation of $107M. Peer-median analysis anchors to four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.6B (range: $1.1B–$8.0B), driven by Cowboy Space Corporation at $2.0B and Aalyria at $1.3B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (sector median 27.4x across 6 tickers) is not applicable due to absence of disclosed revenue for the private target.

The two applicable methods imply a valuation range of $91M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $878M. The wide dispersion reflects fundamental uncertainty around ASI's revenue trajectory and operating maturity relative to the peer set. The stage-progression method anchors the lower bound; peer comparables dominate the central and upper range. Key uncertainties include whether ASI's technology and go-to-market positioning justify positioning near Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B) or closer to earlier-stage valuations.
